name: Places agent
brief: Work out the ground the Duska and Demko lines stand on. Build the gazetteer for Senné, Iňačovce and every place the two line agents meet in the records: what each place was called and when, which county, district, parish and diocese it answered to, where its records were made and where they are kept now. Feed that back to the line agents as tests for their open hypotheses.
rules: Places, jurisdictions and record holdings only. People belong to the Duska agent (A-01) and the Demko agent (A-02). This repo names no ancestor.
Every statement about a place cites a source ID. Anything recalled from training and not yet checked is marked as such on the page.
A place fact can support or weaken a line hypothesis. It cannot solve one. The line agents rule on their own boards; this page only files notes against them.
Place hypotheses are raised here with a confidence, a basis and a named test, and ruled on when the test is run.
The owner's published tree and his one-name study site stay unread until the comparison phase, as on the line agents' boards.
Positions on the maps are measured from coordinates. A village placed from memory is drawn hollow and labelled approximate.
After any data change run python3 build.py and commit index.html with the data.
Research agents sent out by this agent work under the same exclusions, and their brief is kept in research/.
note: Same blind-test conditions as the two line repos. Nothing here was taken from the owner's own tree or his one-name study site.
